about: The payload of `reading.revised` taken whole as a record of the third revision of a schema that grew: the level is a field of the first revision, the layout came with the second (default `week`) and the urgency with the third (default `true`). A delivery written against an earlier revision lacks the fields a later one added and takes their defaults, a field the delivery carries is read as it came and held to its type, and a field the schema does not name is not read. A delivery that lacks the level is refused as any payload that does not fit its schema is: nothing is written and error.execution says so, counted by `refusals`. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the record starts at the values its <sce:set>s give
a delivery of the first revision carries the level alone: the layout and the urgency take their defaults
a delivery of the second revision carries the layout, and the urgency the third added takes its default
a delivery of the third revision carries every field, and no default stands in for a value that was sent
a delivery that lacks the level, a field of the first revision, is refused: nothing is written and error.execution says so
a newer sender's field the schema does not name is not read, and the delivery is taken
a field the schema does not name may hold an object, walked past to the level after it, and the fields the delivery lacks take their defaults
a field with a default is still held to its type when a delivery carries it: a text is no truth value, and the delivery is refused
a delivery with no data lacks the level too, and is refused
